# temps_status_page_webhook (Resource)

Notifies a URL when a status page's state changes. Temps signs every delivery with `secret`, shown only when the webhook is created (an imported webhook has no `secret`).

Import with `<status_page_id>/<id>`.

Required API key permissions: `status_page:create`, `status_page:read`, `status_page:write`, `status_page:delete`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_status_page_webhook" "chatops" {
  status_page_id = temps_status_page.public.id
  url            = "https://hooks.example.com/status"
  enabled        = true
}

# The signing secret is returned once, on create.
output "status_webhook_secret" {
  value     = temps_status_page_webhook.chatops.secret
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `status_page_id` (Number) ID of the status page.
- `url` (String) HTTPS URL that receives the deliveries.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Send deliveries.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Import ID, `<status_page_id>/<id>`.
- `last_failure_reason` (String) Why the last delivery failed.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) Signing secret of the deliveries.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <status_page_id>/<id>
terraform import temps_status_page_webhook.chatops 3/12
```
